name: base-tag: FROM with no tag
input:
FROM python
USER 10001
reason: FROM image without tag (implicit latest)

name: base-tag: FROM with explicit :latest
input:
FROM ubuntu:latest
USER 10001
reason: FROM image with explicit :latest tag

name: base-tag: FROM with uppercase :LATEST
input:
FROM alpine:LATEST
USER 10001
reason: The mutable latest tag is case-insensitive

name: root-user: no USER instruction
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
RUN echo test
reason: No USER instruction (defaults to root)

name: root-user: final USER is root
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
USER root
reason: Last USER instruction is root

name: curl-bash: RUN curl piped to bash
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
RUN curl https://example.com/script.sh | bash
reason: RUN pipes curl output to bash shell

name: curl-bash: RUN wget piped to sh
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
RUN wget http://example.com/script.sh | sh
reason: RUN pipes wget output to sh shell

name: secret-env: ENV PASSWORD with literal value
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
ENV PASSWORD=mypassword
reason: ENV PASSWORD with literal secret value

name: secret-env: ARG API_KEY with literal value
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
ARG API_KEY=sk-1234567890
reason: ARG API_KEY with literal secret value

name: add-remote: ADD with https URL
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
ADD https://example.com/file.txt /app/
reason: ADD with https:// URL as source

name: add-remote: ADD with http URL
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
ADD http://example.com/file.txt /app/
reason: ADD with http:// URL as source

name: apt-recommends: apt-get install without flag
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
RUN apt-get install -y curl
reason: apt-get install missing --no-install-recommends flag

name: apt-recommends: apt install without flag
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
RUN apt install vim
reason: apt install missing --no-install-recommends flag

name: clean: single-stage hardened
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
CMD ["python"]
reason: Pinned base, non-root user, no curl|bash, no secrets, no remote ADD, apt has flag

name: clean: multi-stage with builder and runtime
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc AS builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

FROM python:3.12@sha256:def
USER 10001
COPY --from=builder /build /app
CMD ["python"]
reason: Multi-stage with hardened runtime stage and pinned bases

name: clean: FROM scratch
input:
FROM scratch
COPY binary /
CMD ["/binary"]
reason: FROM scratch still runs as uid 0 by default; rule correctly requires a non-root USER [reconciled]

name: clean: FROM with digest pin
input:
FROM alpine:3.18@sha256:xyz
USER 10001
RUN apk add --no-cache curl
reason: FROM with tag@digest is fully pinned

name: clean: multi-stage FROM stage reference
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc AS build
RUN echo test

FROM python:3.12@sha256:def
USER 10001
COPY --from=build /output /app
reason: FROM stage reference (FROM builder pattern) is allowed

name: clean: ENV with variable reference
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
ENV PASSWORD=$BUILD_TOKEN
reason: ENV PASSWORD with variable reference (not literal) is allowed

name: clean: ARG with placeholder value
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
ARG API_KEY=<please-provide>
reason: ARG API_KEY with placeholder syntax is allowed

name: clean: ENV with changeme value
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
ENV SECRET=changeme
reason: ENV SECRET with 'changeme' special value is allowed

name: clean: curl without piping to shell
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
RUN curl -o /tmp/file.txt https://example.com/file.txt
reason: curl not piped to shell is allowed

name: clean: ADD with local file path
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
ADD requirements.txt /app/
reason: ADD with local file (not URL) is allowed

name: bad: ADD JSON array with remote URL
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
ADD ["https://example.com/tool", "/usr/local/bin/tool"]
reason: JSON-array ADD still fetches a remote URL and must be rejected

name: clean: apt-get with --no-install-recommends
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl
reason: apt-get install with --no-install-recommends flag is allowed

name: clean: USER with non-root numeric ID
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 1000
RUN echo test
reason: USER with non-root numeric ID is allowed

name: clean: USER with non-root username
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER appuser
RUN echo test
reason: USER with non-root username is allowed

name: clean: wget without piping to shell
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
RUN wget https://example.com/file.txt -O /tmp/file.txt
reason: wget not piped to shell is allowed

name: clean: ENV with empty value
input:
FROM python:3.12@sha256:abc
USER 10001
ENV PASSWORD=
reason: ENV PASSWORD with empty value is allowed

name: non-dockerfile: shell script without FROM
reason: File with no FROM line is not a Dockerfile

name: non-dockerfile: YAML configuration without FROM
input:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: my-pod
reason: YAML file without FROM line is not a Dockerfile

name: multi-violation: untagged base + no user + curl|bash
input:
FROM python
RUN curl https://example.com/install.sh | bash
reason: Violates base-tag (no tag), root-user (no USER), curl-bash

name: multi-violation: latest tag + root user + secret ENV
input:
FROM ubuntu:latest
USER root
ENV DATABASE_PASSWORD=secretpass123
reason: Violates base-tag (latest), root-user (USER root), secret-env (PASSWORD)

name: multi-violation: untagged base + apt without flag + remote ADD
input:
FROM node
USER 10001
RUN apt-get install npm
ADD https://example.com/config.json /app/
reason: Violates base-tag (no tag), apt-recommends (no flag), add-remote (https URL)
